'''Holo-scribers''' were devices used during the forging of fake identifications. When the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] hired a [[Tsyklen]] [[Unidentified Tsyklen forger|forger]] to create fake identifications for him and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Hekka]]<ref name="HG" /> circa [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] to [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'' to circa [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] to [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].</ref> she used holo-scribers. Due to the particularly nimble [[Limb/Legends|hands]] that all members of the Tsyklen [[Species/Legends|species]] possessed with seven fingers and two thumbs, she was able to manipulate two holo-scribers at once.<ref name="HG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Holo-scribers were mentioned in the novel ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'' released in [[1997]] as the second book in [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']] written by [[A. C. Crispin]].<ref name="HG" />
